page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.small is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.c1 family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 8 physical cores, operating with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The instance is provisioned with 8.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core. It utilizes the KVM hypervisor for virtualization.

This instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and data hosting. It contains no graphics processing units and does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.c1.small is its highly constrained memory-to-CPU ratio of 1:1. While the dedicated physical cores provide consistent compute performance without hyperthreading interference, the 8.0 GB RAM limit restricts its suitability for memory-intensive applications. This hardware profile is best suited for compute-heavy, low-memory workloads such as batch processing, CPU-bound microservices, and lightweight computational tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.small is an x86_64 compute-oriented server instance within the ecs.c1 family, virtualized via the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, ensuring no hyperthreading overhead. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of RAM, yielding a low memory-to-CPU ratio of 1.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, necessitating external network-attached storage for deployment. Due to the dedicated CPU allocation and low memory footprint, this instance offers a cost-efficient profile for pure compute tasks that do not require large memory allocations. It is suited for workloads such as batch processing, distributed compute nodes, and CPU-bound microservices.
